consent.title: Ku-oggolsiyo
consent.paragraph1: MeritLense gide taamah massoysimtaa qiimeyso dudda xiqsitaanam koh seecoowe. Culum ku-faxih tan; fan gexxuk ku-faxih cultam ixxigta.
consent.paragraph2: Qiimeyso tah abaanamkeh, ku-gacanoo, ku-yangayyi kee ku-ayti cayttaah xagana taamitta; maxcooy kah yewqe dulaali hee mangala ken-xinti luk kah yaqqaye. Taamah culsuh doorit MeritLense kak hinna — taama abeynaay sinni.
consent.agreeLabel: Qiimeyso tah culumuh kee yi-xagana yabatih yan innah taamitti yoh oggoleh.
consent.errorGeneric: Ku-oggolsiyo dacrisak umaane yekke. Qagitak gaabis.

privacy.title: Qeebe Xagana Baaxo
privacy.paragraph1: MeritLense ku-yangayyi kee/hinnay ku-xaggu gacanoo (yangayyih gacinniyok yangayyi duudumta kee xaggu luk), ayti cayttaah tumbule sawra, kee AI kaa caatiise qeefi ku-gacanoowak yewqe tirri, astooyyi kee wohu-hinna maxcooy hayta kee taamitta. Ku-wakti elle-elle viidiyo essero luk tanih, seecu ninna duuduma hinna — qiimeysoh ku-yangayyi gacanoo qala xaggu le.
privacy.paragraph2: Xagana tah ku-ayti caytih, ku-taamah massoysimtaa qiimeyso abaanamkeh, ku-gacanoo kee ku-dudda qeefimkeh, kee ku-qiimeyso dulaali kee tamaggiyyi sahaada abaanamkeh tu-faxxamta.
privacy.paragraph3: Qiimeyso tah gubbi AI kee rikoh qeefi ku-gacanoo xaggu ah, kortisah kee qiimeysah taamitta. Maxcooy doorit caatiisa xagana tan; maggarah doorit hinna — taamah culsuh doorit inkih, qiimeyso tah koh seecoowe mangalaay ken-xinti luk tan.
privacy.paragraph4: MeritLense ku-xagana mi gatana. Oggolsiimte qaagitaanah heemaari (yangayyi xaggut gacsa, kortisa, kee AI qeefi heemaari) qiimeyso qaagitaana tah yaceenimkeh faxximta caddak qala, meqe xagana dacrisi lih ku-xagana taamitan. Ku-maxcooy qiimeyso tah yaqqaye mangala hinnay ejensi luk yaqqayeh.
privacy.paragraph5: Ku-xagana MeritLense xagana dacrisa siyaasa innah dacrisimtah.
privacy.ackLabel: Qeebe xagana baaxo tah akkuyeh yaxxigeh yoh oggolih; yi-inkih xagana, viidiyo, yangayyi, xaggu kee ayti cayttaah xagana luk, yabatih yan qeeqedah taamitam yoh oggoleh.
privacy.errorGeneric: Ku-oggolsiyo dacrisak umaane yekke. Qagitak gaabis.

steps.title: Qimbisak dumu
steps.description: Essero tah aaxagite taamitam sissikuk ablo — 20 sekond inna yaybaxa.

steps.title: Esserok inkih akkuy hinnay ab
steps.description: Esserok inkih iskiriinil bulalta — yaqrimtam faxxek yangayyi astooti xiq.

steps.title: Yangayyih hinnay xaggu le gacin
steps.description: Koh xiqta dooris — esserok aybil duuduma kee xaggu fanat beddelemuh duddta.

steps.title: Saaqa ubul
steps.description: Koh raaqe wakti ginni boodah amol bulalta — wakti gufeh essero rikoh rubimta.

steps.title: Sugte
steps.description: Kah yafte wakti addal ku-sissikuk gacin. Meqe hayto!

cookie.title: Ku-xagana baaxo qhaddarinna
cookie.body: Culte haytuh kee saytu taamitaah faxximta kuukiiwa kee innah tan dacrisa faxxinna. Ku-oggolsiyoh doorimu qeefi kee gatah kuukiiwa faxxinnu; maggaaxa ama inkih taamita mali. Ku-doorit boodah gubbal yan kuukih sugeyal waktik aybil beddeluh duddta.
cookie.necessaryDescription: Culuh, culte haytuh, ku-af kassittaah kee saytu dacrisimtaah faxximta.
cookie.analyticsDescription: Saytu aaxagite faxximtam yaxxigenna kee yasmiyinnah caatiisa.
cookie.marketingDescription: Ni-ololooyyi giffinnah kee wohu-hinna bagul sinnih tan xagana bulalinnah xaguy.
